items.basis: The objection arose from compression of the transport handoff. Source-of-record artifacts already bind the missing truth and generator details: NB1_CDS_GENERATOR_SEMANTIC_CONTRACT_v0.1.md gives C/D/S equations, domain predicates, D-not-C/S-not-D construction, ARMA generation and F09 transform; NB1_LIMIT_GENERATOR_CONTRACT_v0.1.md fully specifies L05-L09 including initialization, noise and mixing; NB1_PACKET_FUNCTION_TRUTHS_v0.1.json and NB1_PACKET_LIMIT_TRUTHS_v0.1.json bind all 18 identities; NB1_PACKET_APQ_REVISION_v0.2.json binds 1..45 Hz natural-frequency domain and exact indexing.

NB1_CHANNEL_RULES_REVISION_v0.1.json already freezes channel-specific PASS/REFUSE/NEED_MORE_INFO rules and multi-label composition; NB1_PACKET_APQ_REVISION_v0.2.json freezes truth-by-channel applicability; alias certificate semantics and independent verification requirement are bound in the same revision and operative handoff.

NB1_PACKET_SEEDS_v0.2.json freezes replicate i=0..15, exact UTF-8 bytes, big-endian digest conversion, modulo rule and deterministic retry suffix. NB1_PACKET_APQ_REVISION_v0.2.json and NB1_EXACT_PACKET_REVIEW_HANDOFF_v0.1.md freeze child labels plus per-generator draw ordering and shapes.

NB1_EXACT_PACKET_REVIEW_HANDOFF_v0.1.md and NB1_PACKET_APQ_REVISION_v0.2.json freeze exact six physical starts, projected-global and recurrence/covariance starts, dedup rule, nuisance bounds, optimizer options, local-minimum and endpoint-adjacent bracket refinement, xatol/maxiter and tie/failure rules.

closure_basis: All source-review BLOCKER/MATERIAL objections are resolved by pre-existing prospective packet authority, not by outcome access or post-result tuning.
No scientific packet change is required from this review.
N-B1 lane packet APQ is closed prospectively, subject to cross-lane integrated packet APQ and later final identity/code/environment binding before execution.
